the vertical beam divergence of a laser diode can be decreased to 16° by using a thin wide-gap barrier layer at the interfaces between waveguide and claddings.

the insertion of thin low refractive index barrier layers at the waveguide-cladding interfaces of a conventional SCH design leads to a decrease in optical confinement, which results in the reduction of the vertical beam divergence.
